The '''Sharlson family''' was a family of [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They lived in unit 2-B of a [[Unidentified residential building (Coruscant)|residential building]] they shared with the [[Sigus family]], the [[Kinalos]] family, and [[Hamedaw|"Old Man" Hamedaw]]. In the aftermath of the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]] and the [[Imperial Civil War]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], much of Coruscant was laid waste and the Sharlsons were forced to flee their home. Their unit was looted and occupied by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial Stormtroopers]].<ref name="Author'sCut" />
